The name matches CrowdStrike's publicly documented Falcon Detects API 'pattern disposition' bit values (the same bitmask exposed via the /detects API's pattern_disposition field), which gives strong external corroboration beyond name convention alone, though no decode table is present in this local KB to verify bit positions.
